The factor roots, collision a=2c, eigenvalue factorization and quadratic contact coefficient were checked algebraically and 19 numerical examples verified. No nonlinear Hopf claim is made.

originality.rationale: The primary 2022 full text gives the vector field, equilibria, Jacobian and selected numerical/Routh analyses for a fixed coefficient triplet but not the fully factored four-parameter stability partition or the codimension-one pinch at a=2c. Its k=0 predecessor cannot imply the reentrant negative-k region. Actual searches against published mathematical findings and external literature found no equivalent theorem. Equivalence of standard Routh conditions was explicitly tested by coefficient comparison. Residual unindexed-work risk remains.

Other publisher supplements or unindexed manuscripts with identical model and sign conventions were not exhaustively inspected.

value.rationale: The four-parameter hidden-attractor model has an unexpected reentrant interval of local equilibrium stability when a>c, collapsing exactly at a=2c with positive quadratic spectral contact. This changes the qualitative stability topology for an entire physically natural feedback-control family and supplies a sharp, b-independent boundary that no fixed-parameter scan yields. It distinguishes genuine instability sectors from marginal spectral points and provides a diagnostic structural tool for future bifurcation studies.
